C218739: The trial will enrol adult participants aged 18 to 75 years with a confirmed diagnosis of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, defined as a Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) score of 12 or greater and a body surface area (BSA) involvement of 10% or greater at screening.
C25532: Participants must meet all of the following inclusion criteria to be eligible for enrolment.
C25370: Participants meeting any of the following exclusion criteria are not eligible for enrolment.
C218740: Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) are defined as women who are biologically capable of becoming pregnant. Women who are postmenopausal (at least 12 consecutive months of spontaneous amenorrhoea) or permanently sterile are not considered WOCBP.
C218741: WOCBP must agree to use a highly effective method of contraception from the time of screening until at least 12 weeks after the last dose of investigational product.
C218742: Participants must comply with the following lifestyle restrictions throughout their participation in the trial.
C218743: Participants must avoid grapefruit, grapefruit juice, and Seville oranges from 7 days prior to the first dose until the end of the treatment period.
C218744: Participants must abstain from alcohol consumption within 24 hours prior to and 24 hours following each study visit.
C218745: Participants should avoid strenuous physical activity within 48 hours prior to scheduled blood sampling visits.
C49628: Participants who fail to meet eligibility criteria at screening will be considered screen failures and their data collected to understand the characteristics of the screened population.
C179373: Rescreening may be permitted once, at the discretion of the investigator, if the screen failure was due to a transient condition that has resolved.

InclData.description_r1: Participants must be aged 18 to 75 years and weigh at least 40 kg.
InclData.description_r2: Participants must have a confirmed diagnosis of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis and have provided written informed consent.

ExclData.description_r1: Participants who have received any biologic agent targeting IL-17, IL-23, or TNF-alpha within 24 weeks prior to randomisation are not eligible.
ExclData.description_r2: Participants who are pregnant or have an active systemic infection are not eligible.
